primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

wikipediaRead.title: Zerah
wikipediaRead.locator: L157–161 says the Bible identifies Zerah as a founder of a Simeonite clan; reference 12 at L194 points to Numbers 26:13. This is relevant to the Simeonite genealogy but does not independently prove that every Zerah mention is the same individual.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版記事は、シメオン系の氏族名の由来となったゼラにも触れています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The section supports a relation to a Simeonite clan, but it does not establish that this profile’s genealogical Zerah is certainly identical with every person bearing the name; relation only.
